title: ReSIDS: A Resilient, Adaptive, runtime-Switchable Federated–Gossip IDS
description:
ReSIDS / ereno-Adaptativo is an intrusion-detection system whose nodes switch between local, gossip and federated learning at runtime, built on Flower and XGBoost.

Version 2.1 lets each node decide its learning mode from the trust level supplied by the federated failure detector Disaster-FD (API 1.9.0): local learning below 30, gossip from 30, federated from 50, with a settle time and a fallback to local learning when no level arrives. Every node keeps the specialists it receives in both modes; per-attack specialists are fused by OR; alarms are raised per window, network-wide and per specialist. The release carries the evaluation of the second paper in four domains (ERENO, improved CICIDS2017, Morris-4 and CICIoT2023) under protocols registered before any run (protocol-v1, fusion-v1, evaluation-v1), including the replay of two recorded Disaster-FD runs, and the scripts and summaries of every result. Byzantine trust remains scoped for v3.
